name: London
description: London preserves the October 2014 TCG pool, with Satellarknight, Shaddoll and Burning Abyss available. Shaddoll and Burning Abyss could share an engine because one Fusion Summon could send monsters from both families to the Graveyard and trigger their effects.

defining_cards.name: Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss
defining_cards.why: Milling up to three cards fueled the Burning Abyss monsters whose effects activated in the Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Cir, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss
defining_cards.why: Cir could revive Dante, and Dante could return Cir to hand when sent to the Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Graff, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss
defining_cards.why: Sending Graff to the Graveyard brought a different Burning Abyss monster directly out of the Deck.

defining_cards.name: El Shaddoll Construct
defining_cards.why: Sending a Shaddoll card to the Graveyard on summon set up another effect while Construct threatened Special Summoned monsters in battle.

defining_cards.name: Shaddoll Fusion
defining_cards.why: An opposing monster summoned from the Extra Deck let this Fusion Spell use Shaddolls straight from the Deck.
